description: TypeError: Cannot read property 'map' of undefined in React component when rendering user list
expectedSolution: Add optional chaining (users?.map) or default to empty array (users ?? []).map()

description: CORS error: Access-Control-Allow-Origin header missing when calling Express API from React frontend
expectedSolution: Install and configure cors middleware: app.use(cors({ origin: 'http://localhost:3000' }))

description: Async operations in for loop running in parallel instead of sequentially, causing race conditions
expectedSolution: Use for...of loop with await instead of forEach, or use Promise.all for parallel with proper handling

description: React Warning: Can't perform state update on unmounted component. Memory leak in useEffect
expectedSolution: Return cleanup function from useEffect to cancel async operations on unmount

description: Next.js Hydration error: Text content does not match server-rendered HTML
expectedSolution: Use useEffect with mounted state to defer client-only rendering, or use next/dynamic with ssr: false

description: Prisma error: Foreign key constraint failed on the field when creating related records
expectedSolution: Use nested create or connect in Prisma query to properly link related records

description: Zod validation error: Expected string, received undefined on optional field in API request body
expectedSolution: Use z.string().optional() or z.string().nullable() for optional fields in the schema

description: TypeScript error: Property does not exist on type 'string | number'. Type narrowing not working in switch statement
expectedSolution: Use typeof check or discriminated union with type guard to narrow the type before accessing properties

description: ReferenceError: Cannot access before initialization. Circular dependency between modules
expectedSolution: Break the circular dependency by extracting shared types to a separate module or using lazy imports

description: JsonWebTokenError: jwt expired when verifying authentication token in Express middleware
expectedSolution: Implement token refresh flow: catch jwt expired error, issue new token using refresh token

description: React useState showing stale value in event handler due to closure over old state
expectedSolution: Use functional update form setState(prev => prev + 1) or useRef to always access current value

description: Error: connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:5432 when connecting to PostgreSQL database
expectedSolution: Ensure PostgreSQL is running on the expected port. Check docker-compose or service status

description: Warning: Each child in a list should have a unique key prop in React map rendering
expectedSolution: Add unique key prop to each element in the list: items.map(item => <Item key={item.id} />)

description: SyntaxError: Cannot use import statement outside a module. ESM/CJS interop issue in Node.js
expectedSolution: Set type: module in package.json or use .mjs extension. Configure tsconfig moduleResolution

description: UnhandledPromiseRejection: Promise rejected but no catch handler attached in async Express route
expectedSolution: Wrap async route handlers in try-catch or use express-async-errors package for automatic error forwarding

description: Vitest mock not working: original function still called despite vi.mock()
expectedSolution: Ensure vi.mock is hoisted to top of file and mock factory returns the correct shape. Check import paths match

description: Tailwind CSS classes not applying in production build, works in development
expectedSolution: Configure content paths in tailwind.config.js to include all template files for proper CSS purging

description: WebSocket connection drops after idle timeout, no automatic reconnection
expectedSolution: Implement heartbeat ping/pong mechanism and exponential backoff reconnection strategy

description: ENOENT: no such file or directory when running Node.js app in Docker container
expectedSolution: Ensure files are properly COPYed in Dockerfile and WORKDIR is set correctly. Check volume mounts

description: Too many re-renders. React limits the number of renders to prevent infinite loop
expectedSolution: Avoid calling setState directly in render. Move to useEffect with proper dependency array or add a condition
